test_std_exception: test that pybind11 throws a standard C++ exception as a Python RuntimeError
test_cross_module_exceptions: test that exceptions thrown from a separate pybind11 cross-module are correctly propagated
test_custom: test custom pybind11 exception types including subclassing and fallback to standard handlers
test_nested_throws: test nested C++ to Python to C++ exception handling and propagation
test_error_already_set_double_restore: test that double-restore of a pybind11 error_already_set raises an internal error
